title: Phase 51E-1: Download route golden characterization
scope: POST /download + GET /download routes in main_web.py (no production code change)

model_execution: run_demo_project (used both; POST with override, GET without)
audit: record_download_export (used both; intended export audit, preserved)

args.project_code: from project_record in POST, hardcoded mapping in GET
args.artifact_name: filename (constructed in POST, export.filename in GET)
args.scenario_id: active_scenario_record.scenario_id if active_scenario_record else None (POST), None (GET)

forbidden_persistence.record_export: NOT called directly (split into 3 purpose-specific helpers; 0 direct calls in main_web.py)

model_execution.run_demo_project: called in both POST and GET, in-memory only, no persistence side effect

characterized_behaviors.form_parsing_POST: 12 fields read from form (project_type, scenario, capacity_mw, tariff_eur_mwh, p50_hours, total_capex_keur, opex_y1_keur, gearing_pct, target_dscr, interest_rate_pct, tenor_years)
characterized_behaviors.form_parsing_GET: Query params with defaults: project_type='Solar', scenario='Base' (empty string -> default)
characterized_behaviors.schema_build_POST: calls _build_schema_from_form + build_projectinputs; on (ValueError, Exception) returns HTMLResponse 400 'Excel generation failed' 'Invalid input: {e}'
characterized_behaviors.runtime_guard_POST_user_created: calls check_runtime_allowed; if not allowed, returns HTMLResponse 400 'Excel generation failed' '{guard_message}'
characterized_behaviors.runtime_snapshot_POST_user_created: calls _resolve_runtime_snapshot_source; rebuilds override from snapshot; sets runtime_project_key from canonical project type (Solar/Wind)
characterized_behaviors.runtime_snapshot_POST_saved_state: mutates runtime_origin='saved_state' if active_scenario_id is set; calls _resolve_runtime_snapshot_source; rebuilds override from snapshot
characterized_behaviors.runtime_seed_POST_template_seeded: TUHO -> 'TUHO', Oborovo -> 'Oborovo', generic -> Solar/Wind from canonical
characterized_behaviors.model_execution: run_demo_project(runtime_project_key, scenario, project_inputs_override=override) for POST; run_demo_project(project_type, scenario) for GET
characterized_behaviors.replay_metadata: constructed with export_type='excel_model_export', workbook_type='values_only_excel_export', export_timestamp=utc_now_iso(), runtime_timestamp=utc_now_iso(), runtime_origin (POST: 'saved_state' if active_scenario else 'factory_base_runtime'; GET: always 'factory_base_runtime')
characterized_behaviors.audit_both: record_download_export called once on success with full provenance context

behavior_quirks: POST has TWO template branches for project_key resolution: user_created (Solar/Wind) vs template-seeded (TUHO/Oborovo/Solar/Wind)
GET has HARDCODED project_code mapping (oborovo/tuho based on project_type) — does not use _project_workspace_from_snapshot
POST mutates runtime_origin='saved_state' in non-user_created branch when active_scenario_id is set
POST uses build_excel_export_for_post_request; GET uses build_values_only_export_for_project (different export builders)
POST uses hardcoded media_type; GET uses export.media_type (may differ)
POST constructs filename in route; GET uses export.filename
GET always passes scenario_id=None to record_download_export; POST passes active_scenario_record.scenario_id (or None)
Inline error HTML in both routes (no Jinja template for download errors)
Top-level except Exception is broad; returns 500 with inline error page on any uncaught exception
artifact_path is a string describing the URL, not a filesystem path
POST captures effective_runtime_origin from _resolve_runtime_snapshot_source but discards it (similar parity quirk to /validate Phase 51D-1)
POST broad except (ValueError, Exception) on schema build is overly broad (same pattern as /compare); preserved as-is

phase51e1_download_route_golden_characte.note: New test suite for this phase (to be added in this PR)

option_A_new_service_module.shape: Mirrors Phase 51B/51C-2/51D-2 pattern: thin route (auth + form + deps + service call + render), service owns orchestration, deps bundle injects helpers
option_A_new_service_module.outcome_dataclass: DownloadRouteOutcome (similar to CompareRouteOutcome / ValidateRouteOutcome; structured payload with bytes_data / media_type / headers for success, error_html / error_status for inline error paths)
option_A_new_service_module.rationale: Same shape as Phase 51 services; minimal scope; preserves all current behavior + quirks

option_B_split_existing_services.modules: Extend app/services/export_service.py and app/services/export_audit_service.py with download-specific helpers
option_B_split_existing_services.rationale: More architecturally clean but more invasive; out of scope for 51E-2; could be Phase 51K or later consolidation

preserved_quirks_required: POST runtime_origin mutation to 'saved_state' in non-user_created branch
POST captures effective_runtime_origin but discards it (parity quirk)
POST uses hardcoded media_type; GET uses export.media_type
POST constructs filename in route; GET uses export.filename
POST broad except (ValueError, Exception) on schema build
Top-level except Exception returns 500 with inline error HTML
Inline error HTML format (no Jinja template for download errors)

guardrails_preserved: flat / min DSCR sculpting not promoted
Generic solar / wind remain exploratory / unvalidated
No lender / bank / audit / certification / SaaS claims
rc1 remains frozen (not touched by any Phase 51 commit)
PR #299 remains closed (no longer active guardrail)
Export audit (record_download_export) preserved as INTENDED behavior from Phase 49

structural_guardrail_recommendation_for_.description: Add structural guards for export services in a future Phase 51F guardrail suite. NOT in scope for 51E-1 to avoid scope creep.
